Name: (AT) Brown Ceramic Pillars
Author: OfInstrumentals
Description:
This is an Alternative Textures version of my Content Patcher mod, which can be found [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4845]here[/url].

I liked the shape of the Ceramic Pillar, but not the color of it. The blue was too cold and clinical, so I recolored the item in brown tones. There are six to choose from.

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI and Alternative Textures.

[b]Installing[/b]
Unzip the file and drop the (AT) Brown Ceramic Pillar-folder in to the Mods-folder.
If you've downloaded this mod previously, you may have a version with a folder that has a bunch of numbers in the name. I recommend deleting that old folder before moving the new one in to the Mods-folder.
